_doc: Known specialist steps for the road kind 'fork' (SPEC 7.2): a move inside the same O*NET minor group (first 4 digits of the SOC code) to a specialist role one step further on, as opposed to the management fork (any SOC 11- target, which needs no table). DRAFT, hand-curated by the matcher lane on 2026-10-30, for the owner to review (BUILD_PLAN T2.4 ASK). Each step keeps only what O*NET itself says: the target is listed in O*NET 31.0 'related occupations' of the source (graph edge close_to with tier Primary-Short or Primary-Long, source onet_database in data/graph/graph.sqlite), is in the same minor group, and has a higher job zone. match.js holds a copy of the from/to pairs (a test keeps the two equal); reference.py reads this file. Leave a step out rather than guess. Not used by any score: it only names the kind.
